rootCause.mechanism: Compose stored generation-qualified subtree summaries around existing normalized affected-entry plans; include captured pending units only in request-local summary. Existing response plans resolve global call presence, so non-AI blocks need no extra measurement refusal.
rootCause.publicMechanism: Mandatory hard-limit estimation invokes projectPromptEnvelope; native preparation explicitly refuses estimate/dump before an HTTP request exists. Capability forwarding is fixed; estimation is not bypassed and no spool fallback is installed.

acceptedDomain.route: Actual OpenAIProvider/local HTTP native plain Chat, initial unlogged strict OpenAI format, strip none/all
cases: new human input with streaming enabled/disabled
better pending duplicate with original media ownership
multiple historical holders separated by unchanged multi-page ranges
acceptedDomain.normalForm: Existing indexed tail normalization and response-plan source ordinals, not a new normalizer. Pending input is captured once, caller-owned values remain unchanged, no pending rows are appended before send.
acceptedDomain.http: Each direct case compares actual complete HTTP byte count, SHA-256 and Content-Length against independent old normalization/conversion. Ignore-tail mutation trips ProgressiveJsonBody served-byte validation during HTTP consumption.
acceptedDomain.lifetime: Caller mutation after first chunk and concurrent append cannot change pinned/retry bytes. Paused acquisition peaks at one unit, retirement returns to zero, unsent release and transport error identity retain original assertions.
